definitions.explanation: A formal exchange of questions and answers, typically following a presentation, lecture, or meeting. A four-character compound combining 質疑 (questioning) and 応答 (response).

examples.japanese: {質疑応答|しつぎおうとう}の{時間|じかん}に{入|はい}ります。
examples.english: We will now move to the Q&A session.

examples.japanese: {講演|こうえん}の{後|あと}に{質疑応答|しつぎおうとう}があった。
examples.english: There was a Q&A session after the lecture.

examples.japanese: {議会|ぎかい}での{質疑応答|しつぎおうとう}は{三時間|さんじかん}にも{及|およ}んだ。
examples.english: The question-and-answer session in the assembly went on for as long as three hours.

notes:
USAGE:
{質疑応答|しつぎおうとう} is used in formal or semi-formal contexts such as presentations, conferences, parliamentary sessions, and press conferences. It is a yojijukugo combining {質疑|しつぎ} (questioning/inquiry) and {応答|おうとう} (response).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {質疑応答|しつぎおうとう}の{時間|じかん} (Q&A time)
- {質疑応答|しつぎおうとう}に{応|おう}じる (to respond to questions)
- {質疑応答|しつぎおうとう}を{行|おこな}う (to conduct a Q&A session)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{質問|しつもん} is the everyday word for a question. {質疑応答|しつぎおうとう} specifically refers to the structured back-and-forth format, not a single question.
